review_summary: Independent design review and independently formulated full-path LP verified the four-slot, eight-path synthetic example, causal contract/action nodes, physical state continuity, costs, exact-tail Benders cut signs and support, and conditional rolling resolution. Current acceptance is limited to this design and synthetic prototype.
limitations: Two compressed blocks are not natural days or original contest time series.
Prices are deterministic and there are no intraday contract amendments in the prototype.
The algorithm is a two-block exact-tail Benders special case, not a general SDDP trainer.
No annual cross-day performance, paper score, or award prediction is certified.
The proposed removal of daily closure concerns the later questions; the first question retains its statement-required closure.
